report_name: Rutland County Council Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify potential increases in cycling trips, forecast demand distribution, and inform the development of the cycle network by analyzing desire lines and school travel demand.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Assessment Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP has been used to identify a pipeline of investment and prioritize infrastructure improvements, such as the Oakham and Uppingham town centre routes and inter-town connections, to position the authority for future active travel funding opportunities and inform developer contributions.
